turns.text: I'm coming out of my cage, and I've been doing just fine
turns.zh: 我从笼子里出来了，我一直过得挺好

turns.text: Gotta, gotta be down because I want it all
turns.zh: 必须，必须低落，因为我什么都想要

turns.text: It started out with a kiss, how did it end up like this?
turns.zh: 一开始只是一个吻，怎么就变成这样了？

turns.text: It was only a kiss, it was only a kiss
turns.zh: 那只是一个吻，只是一个吻

turns.text: Now I'm falling asleep, and she's calling a cab
turns.zh: 现在我快睡着了，而她在叫出租车

turns.text: While he's having a smoke, and she's taking a drag
turns.zh: 他在抽烟，而她也抽了一口

turns.text: Now they're going to bed, and my stomach is sick
turns.zh: 现在他们要去睡了，我的胃一阵恶心

turns.text: And it's all in my head, but she's touching his
turns.zh: 这一切都在我脑子里，但她在摸他的

turns.text: Chest now, he takes off her dress now
turns.zh: 胸口，现在他脱下她的裙子

turns.text: Let me go
turns.zh: 让我走吧

turns.text: I just can't look, it's killing me
turns.zh: 我实在看不下去了，这要了我的命

turns.text: And taking control
turns.zh: 而且控制不住

turns.text: Jealousy, turning saints into the sea
turns.zh: 嫉妒，把圣徒变成一片海

turns.text: Swimming through sick lullabies, choking on your alibis
turns.zh: 在病态的摇篮曲里游着，被你的借口噎住

turns.text: But it's just the price I pay, destiny is calling me
turns.zh: 但这只是我付出的代价，命运在召唤我

turns.text: Open up my eager eyes, 'cause I'm Mr. Brightside
turns.zh: 睁开我渴望的双眼，因为我是乐观先生
